title: Prove a scoped P104 event-attribution criterion and exhibit a strict separator
body:
If all multi-stage event projectors commute with every event projector, one global mask-based attribution exists. A separate non-tight n=8, k=6 Q=0 word has six ordered type-B HOSTs and strict matchings at every stage, but no global strict attribution across the five exhaustive assignments. Its global mask-only attribution exists.

Pins #7869 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956 and #7852. The standalone packet checks the small upstream controls, the central projector example and the exact rational separator. Independent SymPy replay verifies all four q values and the strict failure. Credit DreamingOfClouds and the source notes. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

The general mask-only bridge and the tight RC2 caller branch remain open.
